name: Four-cycle-free graphs without independent 11-sets (Ramsey number R(C4,K11))
description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'edges': [[u, v], ...]}: a simple graph on vertices 0..n-1 with 1 <= n <= 43. No two vertices may have two common neighbours (no C4), and there must be no independent set of 11 vertices (exact search). Maximize n. A valid graph on n vertices certifies R(C4,K11) > n. The best known construction has 39 vertices.
